tasks.title: Add S/MIME/PGP sign & encrypt toggle to the compose 'More Options' menu
tasks.acceptance_prose: The compose window's 'More Options' dropdown (currently only Read Receipt + Priority) gains a 'Sign message (PGP)' and an 'Encrypt message (PGP)' toggle, wired to the existing PGP key at /api/user/v1/pgp. A jest test in compose-toolbar.test.tsx asserts both menu items are present. Existing compose-toolbar tests still pass. Build with npm run build:webpack stays green.
tasks.description: Feature gap found by Playwright story F4: compose has no per-message S/MIME/PGP sign/encrypt control even though PGP key management exists under Settings > Security. Add DropdownMenuCheckboxItem entries 'Sign message (PGP)' and 'Encrypt message (PGP)' to the compose-toolbar 'More Options' menu, dispatching to the existing pgp redux/endpoint. Add a jest test asserting their presence and keep the webpack build working.
